key_reasoning.reason: Streaming red flag applied: the new terminal-chunk success/execution_error classification (_classifyTerminalChunk) and the guaranteed-finalization try/catch wrapper (_dispatchResponse) sit directly on the live stream-processing path used by every chat generation, and exist specifically to fix a production bug (message spins forever, EPMCDME-14855). No exact precedent existed for the success x execution_error decision matrix, even though the recursive nested-thought search (findInProgressThought) and the try/catch guarantee mirror established patterns elsewhere in the same file (markThoughtDone, _sendRequest's catch).

A review-fix round was needed after the initial FE2/FE3 delivery to add nested in-progress thought detection (findInProgressThought) — flagThoughtError was originally only checking the top-level thought list and missed an in-progress thought nested under a parent's children, indicating the initial pass had a real gap rather than being fully specified upfront.
4 files changed per diffstat (2 modified core files — chatGeneration.ts, conversation.ts — plus 2 new test files), mapping to the M band under the actual-mode file-count table.
